Subject: Redlines for Redwood Inference SOW — timing and procurement steps

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- Attached is SOW v3 with the redlines Marissa's team suggested (file: Redwood_SOW_v3_redline.pdf). I also attached a small SLA tracker that maps the measured targets we discussed (redwood-sla-tracker.xlsx).
- Major changes are: clarified data retention window (Section 4), added fallback routing SLA (Section 6), and included an optional on-prem deployment appendix.

Can you confirm who on your side will own procurement and counsel review so we can align timelines? From experience, most customers take 7–14 business days for procurement + legal review, but we can compress if there's urgency. If helpful, Marissa is happy to join a short call with your counsel this week.

Proposed next steps:
1) Let us know procurement point of contact + target sign date
2) If there are redlines from your counsel, please send them as a PDF with comments so we can triage quickly
3) If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute call between your legal/procurement and Marissa this week — propose Wed or Thu morning PT

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,

Tentative timeline from our side: counsel + procurement expect to have initial comments by early next week (week of Oct 18). We do have one quick question: can Redwood confirm the maximum retention period for cached inference logs (the SOW lists a default of 90 days)? If there's flexibility there, that will help counsel frame the ask.

I'll share any comments as a marked-up PDF. If a call is helpful, Evan will propose availability after the initial review.
